description: Pinned RigSpec key allowlists exported from @openrig/cli@0.7.4 packages/daemon/src/domain/rigspec-schema.ts. Verifier diffs its hardcoded sets against this file fail-closed; refresh on upstream bump.

upstream_tarball.recipe: On a networked shell host: npm pack @openrig/cli@0.7.4 && sha256sum openrig-cli-0.7.4.tgz; record the 64-hex digest in tarball_sha256 (or place the tarball at schemas/openrig-cli-0.7.4.tgz and re-run python3 scripts/generate-rigs.py to attest it); then diff the extracted rigspec-schema.ts key sets against RIG_KEYS/POD_KEYS/MEMBER_KEYS/EDGE_KEYS/EDGE_KINDS and update all three local copies together

provenance.refresh: npm pack @openrig/cli@0.7.4 && tar -xzf openrig-cli-0.7.4.tgz package/daemon/assets || git -C <openrig-checkout> show 6d9e8e27:packages/daemon/src/domain/rigspec-schema.ts, then diff RIG_KEYS/POD_KEYS/MEMBER_KEYS/EDGE_KEYS/EDGE_KINDS and update this file + scripts/verify-rigs.sh together
